# third_party/twolayers

Unmodified copy of the `twolayers` package (`src/twolayers` at commit `787d133`, version 0.19.1, AGPL-3.0, same
author). `periciar_lote.py` uses its PDF revision timeline (`linha_do_tempo`) and hidden-text (`peca`) modules.
It is vendored here so that the package can be reproduced without any other repository.
